Results.ReviewText: It has been awhile since I have owned a Weber grill. I have bought probably half a dozen grilles over the years, different brands, sizes, and number of burners. We have had both charcoal and gas grilles. Some seemed to work better than others. I decided this time to go with the Weber Spirit II E-210. We have been using it for the last 4 or 5 weeks. Everything we have cooked has been really good. Assembly was pretty straight forward, it went together easily and the quality is what we expected from Weber. Overall I am happy with this purchase, it is the nicest grill we have bought and I will be buying the griddle option for it next.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

Results.ReviewText: This BBQ is everything that I wanted and more. It heats up to a nice level very quickly, which saves on fuel, and maintains a given temp for the length of time that you want it for. Results.ReviewText:
We purchased the Spirit 2 Grill by Weber approximately 3 weeks ago and have had 2 issues. 
Let me add that we had it delivered assembled from a local dealer. Our first problem was a leaking regulator which Weber promptly sent a replacement for and we were able to use our grill for the first time. The performance of the grill was great and seemed to be a sturdy, well built grill. The following day, wanting to use it again, we ran into our second issue. The starter stopped sparking. I checked and replaced the battery, checked the wiring and everything seemed to be connected properly but would not start. We lit the burners manually and called Weber again. As of this review it has been 2 weeks with no reply from email and our phone calls time out after 1 hour. I had always heard good things about Weber and thought I would spend the extra and get something that would last but I am disappointed. If my problem gets resolved I will edit my review.
Results.Title: 2 issues

Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.
